versions.startupSource:
5 T=0:W=1:Y=1983:P=0:N=100:L=28
   20 PAUSE "YR";Y;",WP";W;",RS";N:Y=Y+1: INPUT "HOW MANY MORE WEAPONS";I: IF I>100 LET I=100
   30 IF I<0 THEN I=0
   40 W=W+I:T=(T=0): IF T=P GOTO 300
   50 INPUT "DECLARE WAR? (Y/N) ";A$: GOSUB 900:A$(L)=A$: PRINT #"A";A$(L)
   60 IF A$="Y"LET T=(T=0): GOTO 345
   70 PAUSE "WAIT FOR YEARS DECISION": INPUT #"B";A(L)
   80 A=A(L): IF A<>1 GOTO 120
   90 PAUSE "PEACE!!!": GOSUB "D":I=INT (W*D/100)+1: IF P=T BEEP I
  100 W=W-I: PAUSE "YOU LOSE ";I: IF P<>T BEEP I
  110 GOTO 20
  120 IF A<>2 GOTO 170
